response.title: Tumour response (RECIST)
response.noneYet: No assessment yet for this study.
response.explainer: RECIST 1.1 measures treatment response by comparing the sum of target-lesion diameters between the baseline study and this follow-up. It needs lesions marked as «target» with a measurement at both baseline and now.

ne.no_target_lesions: No target lesions designated. Draw a bidirectional measurement on a target lesion and designate it here to enable the computation.
ne.baseline_missing: Baseline measurement missing. Add a measurement on the target track at the baseline (earliest) study to compute the change.
ne.current_missing: Follow-up measurement missing. Add a measurement on the target track at this study, or link a follow-up measurement.
ne.unknown: Insufficient data for the RECIST computation.

rationale.CR: Complete response: all target lesions disappeared.
rationale.PR: Partial response: sum of diameters {pct} vs baseline (≥30% decrease).
rationale.SD: Stable disease: {pct} vs baseline, below the PR/PD thresholds.
rationale.PD: Progression: sum {pct} vs nadir (≥20% increase and ≥5 mm).

caps.overLimit: Exceeds RECIST 1.1 caps (max 5 targets total, max 2 per organ).

response.nodalFootnote: * Lymph node: contributes its short axis (RECIST 1.1).

threshold.tooSmall: Below target threshold (≥10 mm; nodes ≥15 mm short axis).

landing.headline: Medical imaging for the open web.
landing.tagline: Open-source platform to upload, view, annotate and share DICOM studies (CT, MRI, …). Mission-locked on improving health.
landing.capabilitiesTitle: What you can do with it
landing.viewerBody: 2D, MPR, 3D volume rendering. Measurements, segmentations, fiducials.
landing.fascicoloBody: Revision history per patient, planning of visits and exams with shared calendar, clinical events, documents and attachments: every change tracked, reversible, mergeable.
landing.aiBody: BiomedCLIP similarity search, hybrid text search across reports, automatic record summaries, and agent-generated annotations. Provenance always clear and tracked.
landing.sharingBody: Link-based or per-grant. Optional DICOM de-identification. Audit trail.
landing.openDataBody: Publish anonymised cases to a public commons. Clone-and-scrub, never mutates the source.
landing.medicalDisclaimer: Not a medical device. bitvision phoenix is not CE/MDR or FDA certified and must not be used for diagnosis, treatment, or any clinical decision-making. For personal health-record use, research and education only. Provided "as is", without warranty; the operator is responsible for GDPR and local health-data compliance. See NOTICE for details.
